architecture.domain: Existing SystemPort.sample returns SystemSnapshot. No domain or port change.
architecture.adapter: Existing LinuxSystem reads /proc/stat and /proc/meminfo on the service worker; the five-second subscription is unchanged.
architecture.client: Desktop stores only changed snapshots, resolves current Host::surfaces membership and requests exact role/instance redraws. Connected hosts borrow effective layouts; disconnected saved profiles are not enumerated. Frozen drag/resize sources and their painted preview retain their existing lifecycle.
architecture.framework: Existing Effects.redraw_surface and native frame demand are used; no widget policy, new bounds API, renderer or compositor change.

local_checks.fixture_correction: The initial resize fixture omitted the physical Press required after Edit cancels old gestures; only the fixture was corrected. Production behavior was unchanged.

native_observation.scope: One native output with a standalone System widget; submitted-frame observations only

limits: This records submitted-frame counters, not GPU execution, scanout, video FPS, CPU savings or RSS savings.

Native coverage is one stable 1x virtual output with a standalone System group. Transitive groups, named fallback/disconnected profiles, hidden/error/unchanged values and frozen drag/resize routing are covered by nine source tests.
The 300 MiB RSS target remains unmet by the prior measured video workload; this slice has no new matched CPU/RSS measurement.
Saved Wi-Fi credential recovery and native display Keep/Revert acceptance remain separate shell gaps. Accessibility remains deferred.
